Thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) is a central biomarker in the Danish healthcare system's standardized clinical evaluation of patients newly diagnosed with [[atrieflimren|atrial fibrillation]] [^src1]. Because thyroid disease can be an underlying cause of atrial fibrillation, measuring TSH is a critical diagnostic step to identify potential endocrine drivers of the arrhythmia [^src1]. 

Within the national quality registry for atrial fibrillation (AFDK), TSH measurement is tracked via [[indikator-3|Indicator 3]] [^src3]. This quality indicator measures the proportion of newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients who have their TSH levels tested within a specific timeframe relative to their initial diagnosis [^src4]. The clinical standard for this indicator requires that at least 95% of eligible patients receive the test within the defined window (e.g., from 60 days before to 30 days after the diagnosis date) [^src2]. 

Despite the clear clinical guidelines, national performance has struggled to meet this high standard. In one reporting period, only 76% of newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients nationwide received a TSH measurement within the 60 days prior to 30 days post-diagnosis window [^src10]. The [[afdk-styregruppe|AFDK Steering Group]] has assessed that there are systemic challenges contributing to this shortfall, particularly regarding the use of varying and inconsistent laboratory codes for TSH measurements in the [[labka|LABKA]] database [^src1]. Consequently, the steering group has emphasized the need for greater clinical focus on ensuring TSH is measured for all newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients [^src1]. 

To accurately capture these measurements across different regions and laboratory systems, AFDK relies on data linkage with the national Laboratory Database and utilizes a comprehensive list of laboratory test codes [^src8]. These include [[npu27547-p-thyrotropin|NPU27547]], [[np04199-p-thyrotropin|NPU04199]], [[np04200-p-thyrotropin|NPU04200]], [[np03624-p-thyrotropin|NPU03624]], [[np03578-p-thyrotropin|NPU 03578]], [[dnk35895-p-thyrotropin|DNK35895]], [[ass00039-p-thyrotropin|ASS00039]], [[ass00136-p-thyrotropin|ASS00136]], [[ass00647-p-thyrotropin|ASS00647]], [[as000646-p-thyrotropin|AS000646]], [[ass00650-p-thyrotropin|ASS00650]], [[epc00002-p-thyrotropin|EPC00002]], and [[rsd03382-p-thyrotropin|RSD03382]] [^src4] [^src9]. The exact time window for the indicator has seen adjustments in reporting definitions, ranging from 2 months before to 1 month after, to 150 days before to 30 days after the diagnosis date, reflecting ongoing methodological refinements in the registry's tracking capabilities [^src2] [^src9].

## Claims

- Styregruppen vurderer, at der dels kan være udfordringer med forskellige koder for en TSH måling i LABKA og dels bør der sættes større fokus på at få målt TSH hos patienter med nydiagnosticeret atrieflimren [^src1] (afdk-styregruppe, indikator-3, labka, thyreoideastimulerende-hormon-tsh)
  Type: policy-assessment
  Page: 29
  Source: wikis/rkkp-afdk/raw/AFDK_2023.pdf, pages 26-30
- Indikator 3 har standarden ≥ 95 % for andelen af nydiagnosticerede patienter med atrieflimren, som får målt TSH fra 2 måneder før, til 1 måned efter 1. diagnosedato [^src1] (atrieflimren, thyreoideastimulerende-hormon-tsh, indikator-3)
  Type: quality-standard
  Page: 6
  Source: wikis/rkkp-afdk/raw/AFDK_2024.pdf, pages 6-10
- Indikator 3 måler andelen af nydiagnosticerede patienter med atrieflimren, som får målt TSH fra 60 dage før til 30 dage efter 1. diagnosedato [^src1] (atrieflimren, thyreoideastimulerende-hormon-tsh)
  Type: quality-indicator
  Page: 105
  Source: wikis/rkkp-afdk/raw/AFDK_2024.pdf, pages 101-105
- For indikator 3 er tælleren patienter i nævneren, som har fået målt TSH mindst én gang fra 60 dage før til 30 dage efter 1. diagnosedato [^src1] (thyreoideastimulerende-hormon-tsh)
  Type: definition
  Page: 105
  Source: wikis/rkkp-afdk/raw/AFDK_2024.pdf, pages 101-105
- Indikator 3: Andelen af nydiagnosticerede patienter med atrieflimren, som får målt TSH fra 150 dage før til 30 dage efter 1. diagnosedato [^src1] (thyreoideastimulerende-hormon-tsh, atrieflimren)
  Type: quality-indicator
  Page: 91
  Source: wikis/rkkp-afdk/raw/AFDK_2025.pdf, pages 91-95
- På landsplan fik 76% af de nydiagnosticerede patienter med atrieflimren målt TSH i perioden fra 60 dage før til 30 dage efter diagnosedatoen [^src1] (indikator-3, atrieflimren, thyreoideastimulerende-hormon-tsh)
